saw_lines: Parents buy kids clothes when a size runs out or a festival nears, so the first look decides the order.
So the reason to buy must sit in line one, since a sale banner gives parents no reason to trust you.
Your site shows 2021 reviews on fit, yet 0 of 26 ads carry a proof number. Put a review count on every creative and open two ads with a fit quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 2021 reviews on fit, yet 0 of 26 ads carry a proof number. Parents need a reason to trust a sale. Put a review count on every creative and open two ads with a fit quote.

4 of 9 copy ads open on the same mid season sale line, so a buyer who scrolls past sees the same pitch. Write two new openers from your knit caps and full sleeve styles, each tested beside the sale line.

17 of 26 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so buyers get a product grid and no reason to stop. Add three story ads of children wearing the knit caps and full sleeves, each with one reason to click.
All 26 ads say Shop now but send buyers to 8 different pages. A sale click that lands on a generic page loses the buyer. Match each button to its page, such as Shop sale for the end of season ads.
